body:
The Convergence Leadership Project .

 It’s a way for you, your congregation, or a small group within your congregation to gain training in Christian spiritual activism … aligning your heart (your spiritual life), your head (your theological understanding), and your hands (practical action in your daily life) to work for the common good (caring for the planet , addressing poverty and economic inequality, and working for peace among races, religions, and nations, so all people , no exceptions, can live with dignity, belonging, and freedom.

 You’ll gain access to high quality online training, in-person events, and month-by-month guidance to get from here (wherever you are now) to there (being equipped and aligned for spiritual activism in these challenging times).

 I hope you’ll consider being part of it. More information here.
